panel.label: Flycam Keys
panel.name: tab_plus_flycam_mouse
panel.text: The flycam you fly with the keyboard and the mouse (turned on in the Charis menu).

button.label: Restore Defaults
button.name: restore_defaults
button.tool_tip: Puts every setting on this tab back to its default.

combo_box.name: mouse_mode
combo_box.tool_tip: How the mouse turns the flycam. While the right button is held: a short click still opens the right-click menu. All the time: the cursor is hidden while you fly; hold Alt to get it back.

combo_box.item.label: While the right button is held
combo_box.item.name: right_button

combo_box.item.label: All the time (Alt for the cursor)
combo_box.item.name: always

slider.label: Turn speed
slider.name: mouse_sens
slider.tool_tip: How far the flycam turns for a move of the mouse. 1 turns as far as in mouselook (its mouse sensitivity is used too).

slider.label: Flying speed
slider.name: speed
slider.tool_tip: How fast the flycam flies on the keys (1 = normal, up to 50). The mouse wheel also changes it while you fly (hold Shift, Ctrl or Alt to zoom instead); Cancel keeps what the wheel set.

slider.label: Faster with Shift (x)
slider.name: boost
slider.tool_tip: How many times faster the flycam flies while Shift is held.

slider.label: Smoothness (seconds)
slider.name: smooth
slider.tool_tip: How gently the flycam starts and stops on the keys: about how long it takes to reach full speed and to come to a stop. 0 starts and stops at once.

slider.label: Tilt speed (deg/s)
slider.name: roll_speed
slider.tool_tip: How fast Q and E tilt the camera, in degrees a second (3 times as fast with Shift).

panel.text: While you fly: W A S D move, Space and C go up and down, Q and E tilt the camera, Shift flies faster and the mouse wheel changes the speed. The 3D mouse has its own settings (Move & View > 3Dconnexion devices). The gamepad's flycam is set on Action Mappings.
